title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on How to Apply the Law to the Act of Using Official Firearms as Pledge for Debt

articles.content_en:
No. 4 (1998) of the Interpretations of the Supreme People's Procuratorate
To the People's Procuratorate of Chongqing Municipality:
Your letter Yu Jian (Yan) [1998] No. 8, the Request for Instructions on Whether the Act of Using Official Firearms for Loan Pledge Constitutes a Crime and the Applicable Law, has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
A person lawfully equipped with official firearms who, in violation of legal provisions, uses the official firearms as a pledge for a loan, causing the firearms to be under the control and use of a person not lawfully authorized to possess them, thereby seriously endangering public security, shall constitute a form of the act of illegally lending firearms as provided in Article 128, paragraph 2 of the Criminal Law, and shall be investigated for criminal liability for the crime of illegally lending firearms; a person who accepts the pledge of the firearms and commits a crime shall, in accordance with Article 128, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, be investigated for criminal liability for the crime of illegally possessing firearms.
Supreme People's Procuratorate
November 3, 1998
